description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter called VodCardAdapter for displaying a list of VodItem objects in a card format within an Android application. It manages view creation, data binding, and user interaction through click events.

classes.name: VodCardAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that provides the binding logic for displaying VodItem objects as cards, including view holder inner class and data binding methods.

classes.name: VodViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class extending RecyclerView.ViewHolder that holds references to the views within each VodItem card and binds data to those views.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_vod_card layout and creates a VodViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the VodItem data at a given position to the view holder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of VodItems in the list.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a VodItem's data to the view elements and sets up click listener.
